verdict.rationale: Whether a code review product publishes its source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions a public repository or an open-source license for Greptile itself. Self-hosting via Docker Compose and a free offer for OSS contributors are adjacent features and do not show the product's source is readable under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
